styleSelection.reason: Loose ink-and-wash appearance with a pale foundation, distinct local-colour planes and dry shared shadows. The precise-watercolor value scheduler prevents the ink-and-wash two-band profile from depositing the entire sunlit meadow in one averaged olive foundation; sparse sepia drawing still supplies fine structure.

families.referenceCue: The upper right hillside is a broad lemon-olive plane interrupted by dark tree groups and a pale rising footpath. One connected light local-color wash; preserve the path and lose detail with distance.
A narrow sunlit slope and warm winding path emerge between cool trees on the left. Pale wash, irregular dry boundary against woodland, no grass stippling.
Cool blue-grey olive crowns form an interlocking diagonal woodland belt. Connected light underwash, fully dry, then a coherent mixed-dark glaze across adjacent crowns; selected trunk lines only.

The large yellow-green foreground slope surrounds the pale central path. Broad luminous wash with restrained olive half-tones, broken lost edges in the grass, crisp edge only at the bend beneath the central tree.
The strongest dark tree masses frame the left side of the central path. Dry connected shadow glaze across crowns and stems; a few branching sepia gestures restore the tree structure on dry paint.
Small cool grey-green crowns in the upper left stay grouped and simpler than the focal foreground tree. A light mass followed by a restrained connected dry glaze; no outline around every crown.
